name: vshoon
description: VShoon product sources, overlaid onto a pinned Code - OSS core.

scripts.build: node scripts/sync-vsearch-monaco.mjs && node scripts/core-exec.mjs run compile-client && node scripts/core-exec.mjs run gulp compile-extensions
scripts.test:dbconn: node scripts/core-exec.mjs run gulp compile-extension:vshoon-dbconn && node scripts/test-extension.mjs vshoon-dbconn
scripts.test:decom: node scripts/core-exec.mjs run gulp compile-extension:vshoon-decom && node scripts/test-extension.mjs vshoon-decom
scripts.test:vsearch: node scripts/core-exec.mjs run gulp compile-extension:vshoon-vsearch && node scripts/test-extension.mjs vshoon-vsearch
scripts.test:vssh: node scripts/core-exec.mjs run gulp compile-extension:vshoon-vssh && node scripts/test-extension.mjs vshoon-vssh
scripts.test:browser: node scripts/core-exec.mjs run transpile-client && node scripts/core-exec.mjs run test-browser-no-install -- --browser chromium-msedge --runGlob **/vshoon/test/browser/**/*.test.js
scripts.test:file-dialog: node scripts/core-exec.mjs run transpile-client && node scripts/core-exec.mjs run test-browser-no-install -- --browser chromium-msedge --runGlob **/vshoon/test/browser/fileDialog.test.js
